integrity: The result is proved analytically from Parseval and sharp scalar inequalities. The finite verifier is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a torsion-free discrete abelian group and exactly one nontrivial unordered pair-sum collision. It does not cover multiple collisions, torsion, exponents other than \(4\), near-extremizer stability, or finite cyclic sampling.
title: Sharp \(L^2\)-to-\(L^4\) constants for a single additive collision
